Overview Endpoints

Endpoints

GET /forecast

Returns a 7-day forecast for a city.

ParameterInRequiredDescription
cityqueryyesCity name, e.g. Sofia
unitsquerynometric or imperial

GET /locations/{id}

Returns details for a saved location.

GET /locations

Lists saved locations. Results are paginated: pass the cursor value from the previous response's next_cursor field. Use limit (max 100) to set the page size.

POST /alerts

Creates a severe-weather alert subscription. Send a JSON body with location_id and callback_url.
